profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA. It trades under ticker IBM and has CIK 0000051143. Its most recent 10-K reports revenue of 67535000000 USD for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31. IBM's product page describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform for data governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance, available on any cloud or on-premises with modular deployment.

The page states that OpenPages includes an interactive GRC Canvas, embedded AI for classification and issue creation, and API-based integration with watsonx.ai or third-party models. It also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects. IBM says IDC recognized it as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, saving thousands of manual hours. IBM's AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, IBM watsonx.governance, and IBM watsonx. IBM watsonx.governance is noted as a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant (June 2026).

IBM has 448 legal matters recorded in New York.
